heading: 25 October 2026 — eight-group replication: strong controls narrow the learned advantage
body:
25 October 2026 — eight-group replication: strong controls narrow the learned advantage
The prespecified warm day-to-late replication is complete: eight new synthetic base timetable groups, nested 40/80-trip variants and three solver seeds. These are eight base grouping units for this development study, not 48 independent timetables. All 16 prior acquisitions were admitted and all 384 active assignments were attempted with valid operational endpoints. There were 371 strict method successes, 11 retained intermediate endpoints after later method failures, and two valid-prior fallbacks. Both fallback workers (GNN and GNN_day, 50607/40/seed73) exited with code -6; the cause remains unresolved and no retry or replacement was performed.
The strong direct fixed-route charging control qualified in all 48 assignments, with timely new physically admitted candidates and native OPTIMAL status. Both learned families failed the frozen continuation rule: mean savings beyond Cover+CA1 were 0.0386688% for GNN and 0.1997028% for CatBoost, measured as (control cost minus learned cost) divided by common prior late electricity cost E0. The required margin was greater than 1%E0, together with positive group medians in at least six of eight groups. Both had positive medians in seven groups, but neither met the mean margin. CatBoost remains the secondary family; it is not promoted after these outcomes. The earlier four-group GNN result (1.2318882%E0) is preserved separately and is not pooled to rescue the new gate.
GNN improved over unchanged prior by 23.4267%E0, over strong fixed-route QP by 8.7353%E0 and over the fixed-fleet full-movement solver by 3.4761%E0. Its gain beyond random was only 0.1706%E0. The large gains from replanning therefore do not establish a large incremental learning contribution beyond competent classical restriction. These are complete warm-policy comparisons paying loading, inference, construction, search, replay and finalization, not ranker-only or cold-start speedup claims.
Target-price GNN scoring versus the same frozen model scored with day prices gave mean 0.1206672%E0 and a median rounding to zero: 23 wins, 15 losses and 10 near-zero operational pairs. Pool intervention records existed for 47/48 pairs and all 47 changed. This is heterogeneous fixed-model conditioning evidence, not a comparably trained tariff-blind comparison or causal learned-price-information result. Models receive linear tariff a, not curvature b.
Decision: stop expanding the present policy or model families. Next inspect narrowly allowed TRAIN metadata for within-timetable tariff coverage, label provenance, conditional label variation and group aliases before considering more training. The failed practical margin is not a proof of zero effect or equivalence. Generic learned pruning remains prior art; no publication-readiness claim follows. The objective is integrated system cost c+a'L+0.5L'BL; fleet is fixed to a feasible prior and size-dependent power changes with trip count. No unrestricted certificate or population generalization is established. The closed campaign, finalizer and compact export used 12,573.69 measured process CPU seconds and 12,984.00 elapsed-sum seconds, within the prospectively selected 8 CPU-hour/10 wall-hour package; separate historical unknown review CPU remains unchanged.
